storyline: Two girls find a brown seed. After giving the seed to one of the girls, they ran to a house and the seed girl is later called away by a man and left alone. She looks sad and regretful. The man goes inside the house. At the end of the video, it shows the house.

characters.appearance: A fair-skinned girl with short, light brown hair styled in a bob with a small ponytail on the side. She wears a white, short-sleeved shirt with ruffled edges and a red skirt, with visible white stockings and shoes.
A fair-skinned girl with long blonde hair, adorned with red flower-like hair accessories. She wears a white long-sleeved dress.
A pale-skinned man with a dark mustache and hair, dressed in a dark suit and bow tie.

scenes.environment: A vast field with a muted color palette, with a distant horizon and a body of water in the background. The sky is overcast with clouds, and there are some rocks scattered around.
A two-story house with a dark color palette, with stairs leading up to a porch. The house appears to be old-fashioned and has a distinctive chimney.

shot_alignment.source_narrative: Girl 1 approaches Girl 2, who is hiding in a bush. Girl 1 reveals a brown seed she found and gives it to Girl 2.
The two girls excitedly run together across the field towards a distant house.
A man stands on the porch of a house, looking somber, and sighs.
Girl 1 reacts with shock and sadness as the environment darkens dramatically. She is then shown standing alone and dejected in the field, the seed discarded on the ground.
The man gestures for Girl 1 to come towards the house entrance. She walks sadly past him onto the porch and towards the door, and he turns to follow her.
A wide view shows the imposing house under a dark, cloudy sky as a single petal or leaf flutters down.
